title: Local Engine (XTTS Default)
desc: The private, local cloning engine — the only engine installed by default.
lede: XTTS is the default local engine: a private, on-machine voice-cloning engine that needs no account. It's the bundled example of a local engine.
body:
At a glance
  • The only engine installed by default.
  • Runs locally — private and free to run.
  • Clones a voice from samples into a reusable profile.
  • A GPU makes it much faster.

Why a local engine is the default

Local-first means your audio never has to leave the machine. XTTS ships as the default so you can produce a full audiobook with no account, no API key, and no per-word cost.

What XTTS is & GPU needs

XTTS is a neural voice-cloning engine. It runs on CPU but is dramatically faster on a CUDA GPU. Its model is downloaded on first use; see First Run.

Latents & the voice profile

A clone is captured as a compact voice profile. XTTS turns your samples into latents that represent the voice; that profile is what gets reused for synthesis. Profiles are kept separate from a voice's identity so the same voice can carry assets for more than one engine.

Strengths & tuning

Quality depends most on your samples. Clean, consistent recordings clone best. See Voice Cloning Quality for heuristics, and Engine Settings & Verification to configure and test it.
